verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs say designers can prototype interactions by connecting boards that act as screens, and they advertise interactive prototypes. A community user reports the prototype feature works well, which supports the core no-code screen-wiring part of the story. Missing for 10: documented trigger types, transition/animation options, overlay support, and hands-on detail beyond a single positive comment.

support.subject: As a designer, I can wire screens into clickable prototypes with triggers, transitions, and overlays — no code required

citations.quote: Penpot allows you to prototype interactions by connecting boards, which can act as screens.
